strength

compound

pull

beginner

- horizontal_flexion
- vertical_pulling

- abdominals

- shoulders
- triceps

Equipment:

- other

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- core_strength_and_stability
- abdominal_muscle_endurance

Contraindications:

- Individuals with lower back pain or injuries should avoid excessive spinal flexion movements.

Exercise Variations:

- name: Otis-Up with Dumbbells, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Otis-Up with Medicine Ball, equipment: medicine ball

Substitution Options:

- name: Bicycle Crunches, force: pull, level: beginner
- name: Mountain Climbers, force: push-pull, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Secure your feet and lay back on the floor. Your knees should be bent. Hold a weight with both hands to your chest. This will be your starting position.
- Initiate the movement by flexing the hips and spine to raise your torso up from the ground.
- As you move up, press the weight up so that it is above your head at the top of the movement.
- Return the weight to your chest as you reverse the sit-up motion, ensuring not to go all the way down to the floor.
